key_insight: WorldLatent proposes a shared 4D representation—3D space evolving over time—for world perception and generation. The title suggests an ambition similar to GPT: use a common representation to connect diverse tasks.
problem_solved: The paper targets the lack of a unified representation for 4D spatiotemporal vision, which could connect understanding dynamic scenes with generating them.
method: Represent dynamic worlds in a unified 4D latent space, as indicated by the title.
